basic_profile.bio: Hi! I'm Sarah, a recent graduate with a Master's in Curriculum and Instruction, living in the Midwest. I've been teaching for a few years, but I'm currently exploring career options that allow me to use my skills in new ways outside of the traditional classroom. I'm passionate about education and technology, especially how they intersect. When I'm not online, I enjoy hiking, reading, and trying out new recipes. My online hours are mostly in the evenings and weekends. I'm happily single and focusing on my career and personal growth.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a Bachelor's in Elementary Education and a Master's in Curriculum and Instruction. My expertise is in developing educational content and understanding learning processes. I have experience in teaching, lesson planning, and instructional design, which I've developed through formal education and hands-on teaching.
